resources.string: MAC addresses and wake settings; choosing a profile switches the active server.

If a server has not answered when the wait time runs out, wake it again with new packets and wait once more. Applies to all servers, file sources and DLNA; the quick check when the app returns is never repeated.
Receiver is running. Apps on your network can find this device.
Receiver is not running. Enable it and allow local network access to receive media.
DLNA servers found on the network. Wake-on-LAN wakes a sleeping server before browsing when auto-wake is on.
Receiver switches take effect immediately. Apply the device name with Save below the field.
Different MAC addresses are saved: %1$s. One machine has one MAC; enter the correct one or apply the first to all services.
Wake-on-LAN is not set up: “Retry” only checks once more. Turn the server on yourself or set up Wake-on-LAN in Settings.
TVHeadend is not responding. Wake-on-LAN is not set up – turn the server on and try again.
TVHeadend is not responding, even after a wake attempt. Check that the server is on and on the network.
